lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag vadaha(n)s mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Raag Wadahans, First Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਮਲੀ ਅਮਲੁ ਨ ਅੰਬੜੈ ਮਛੀ ਨੀਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: amalee amal na a(n)baRai machhee neer na hoi ||
lines.translation: To the addict, there is nothing like the drug; to the fish, there is nothing else like water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਸਹਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਤਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo rate sahi aapanai tin bhaavai sabh koi ||1||
lines.translation: Those who are attuned to their Lord - everyone is pleasing to them. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਵੰਞਾ ਤਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੇ ਨਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree va(n)njaa kha(n)neeai va(n)njaa tau saahib ke naavai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, cut apart into pieces, a sacrifice to Your Name, O Lord Master. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਰੁਖੜਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib saphalio rukhaRaa a(n)mrit jaa kaa naau ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the fruitful tree; His Name is ambrosial nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤ ਭਏ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jin peeaa te tripat bhae hau tin balihaarai jaau ||2||
lines.translation: Those who drink it in are satisfied; I am a sacrifice to them. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ਵਸਹਿ ਹਭੀਆਂ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai kee nadar na aavahee vasahi habheeaa(n) naal ||
lines.translation: You are not visible to me, although You dwell with everyone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਖਾ ਤਿਹਾਇਆ ਕਿਉ ਲਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਰ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tikhaa tihaaiaa kiu lahai jaa sar bheetar paal ||3||
lines.translation: How can the thirst of the thirsty be quenched, with that wall between me and the pond? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਾਣੀਆ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak teraa baaneeaa too saahib mai raas ||
lines.translation: Nanak is Your merchant; You, O Lord Master, are my merchandise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਧੋਖਾ ਤਾ ਲਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: man te dhokhaa taa lahai jaa siphat karee aradaas ||4||1||
lines.translation: My mind is cleansed of doubt, only when I praise You, and pray to You. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Wadahans, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਕੂਕੇ ਕਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gunava(n)tee sahu raaviaa niragun kooke kaai ||
lines.translation: The virtuous bride enjoys her Husband Lord; why does the unworthy one cry out?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਥੀ ਰਹੈ ਤਾ ਭੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਣ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: je gunava(n)tee thee rahai taa bhee sahu raavan jaai ||1||
lines.translation: If she were to become virtuous, then she too could enjoy her Husband Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਰੀਸਾਲੂ ਕੀ ਧਨ ਅਵਰਾ ਰਾਵੇ ਜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa ka(n)t reesaaloo kee dhan avaraa raave jee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My Husband Lord is loving and playful; why should the soul-bride enjoy anyone else? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਮਣ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਗਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: karanee kaaman je theeai je man dhaagaa hoi ||
lines.translation: If the soul-bride does good deeds, and strings them on the thread of her mind,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਕੁ ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਲੀਜੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਪਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: maanak mul na paaeeai leejai chit paroi ||2||
lines.translation: she obtains the jewel, which cannot be purchased for any price, strung upon the thread of her consciousness. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਹੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਨ ਜੁਲਾਂ ਆਖਾਂ ਅੰਮੜੀਆਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: raahu dasaaee na julaa(n) aakhaa(n) a(n)maReeaas ||
lines.translation: I ask, but do not follow the way shown to me; still, I claim to have reached my destination.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਅਕੂਅਣਾ ਕਿਉ ਥੀਵੈ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tai sah naal akooanaa kiu theevai ghar vaas ||3||
lines.translation: I do not speak with You, O my Husband Lord; how then can I come to have a place in Your home? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ekee baaharaa doojaa naahee koi ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the One Lord, there is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਲਗੀ ਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tai sah lagee je rahai bhee sahu raavai soi ||4||2||
lines.translation: If the soul-bride remains attached to You, then she shall enjoy her Husband Lord. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 1 ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Wadahans, First Mehl, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਰੀ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣ ਲਾਇਆ ਭੈਣੇ ਸਾਵਣੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: moree run jhun laaiaa bhaine saavan aaiaa ||
lines.translation: The peacocks are singing so sweetly, O sister; the rainy season of Saawan has come.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਮੁੰਧ ਕਟਾਰੇ ਜੇਵਡਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੋਭੀ ਲੋਭ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere mu(n)dh kataare jevadaa tin lobhee lobh lubhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Your beauteous eyes are like a string of charms, fascinating and enticing the soul-bride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਵੰਞਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere darasan vitahu kha(n)neeai va(n)njaa tere naam vitahu kurabaano ||
lines.translation: I would cut myself into pieces for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; I am a sacrifice to Your Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਮਾਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਹੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਣੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa too taa mai maan keeaa hai tudh bin kehaa meraa maano ||
lines.translation: I take pride in You; without You, what could I be proud of?

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੂੜਾ ਭੰਨੁ ਪਲੰਘ ਸਿਉ ਮੁੰਧੇ ਸਣੁ ਬਾਹੀ ਸਣੁ ਬਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: chooRaa bha(n)n pala(n)gh siu mu(n)dhe san baahee san baahaa ||
lines.translation: So smash your bracelets along with your bed, O soul-bride, and break your arms, along with the arms of your couch.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਤੇ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇਦੀਏ ਮੁੰਧੇ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਤੋ ਅਵਰਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ete ves karedeee mu(n)dhe sahu raato avaraahaa ||
lines.translation: In spite of all the decorations which you have made, O soul-bride, your Husband Lord is enjoying someone else.
